title: ReorderPipelineStepsRequest
description: PUT /api/pipelines/:id/steps/order body (HEL-407; contract narrowed to trunk-only by HEL-908, design.md decision 15 / non-goal waiver #2). `stepIds` is the pipeline's TRUNK step ids (the position-0 chain from the root) in their new relative order, and must be exactly a permutation of the pipeline's current trunk step ids -- a missing trunk id, an unexpected id (including any tail id, which this endpoint never accepts), or a duplicate all fail with 422. On success, `parentStepId` is relinked along the requested order (stepIds[0]'s parent becomes the pipeline root, stepIds[i]'s parent becomes stepIds[i-1] for i > 0) and every trunk step's position is written as 0, within a single transaction; a rejected request leaves every position and parentStepId unchanged. A moved trunk step's own tail (if any) follows it automatically, since a tail's parentStepId already references the trunk step's id rather than a positional slot.
